title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
title_zh: 德国前情报局长因涉嫌间谍和叛国被捕
lead: August Hanning, who led Germany's foreign intelligence service from 1998 to 2005, has been arrested on suspicion of espionage and treason. A former colleague is also accused of passing him around 2,000 classified documents.

paragraphs: August Hanning, who headed Germany's Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from 1998 to 2005, has been arrested on suspicion of espionage, treason and obtaining classified information for a foreign power, according to the German Federal Prosecutor's Office. Since leaving the BND, Hanning has worked as a private consultant. Prosecutors claim he used classified intelligence to draft an analysis for one foreign intelligence service and maintained contact with another foreign spying service. Investigators have not said which foreign powers were involved.

Police also arrested former BND employee Manfred D, who is accused of passing Hanning about 2,000 classified documents in exchange for money. Manfred D served as Hanning's bureau chief and remained in the BND until this year. He faces charges of aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage. Local media reported that Hanning was arrested at his home in Nordwalde near Münster, while Manfred D was arrested in Bavaria. Hanning is due in court on Wednesday, and Manfred D will appear on Tuesday.

Prosecutors say Manfred D, who also served as chief of staff for Hanning's successors between 2012 and 2026, used his position to access highly confidential information, which he then passed to Hanning for payment. They stated that over the years Manfred D provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many containing classified information meant only for the BND's internal use. On one occasion, Hanning allegedly used classified intelligence to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service, though it is unclear whether the material reached its intended recipient.

Hanning is also accused of being in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed political information over several years, partly based on material from Manfred D. Local media say the alleged possession of intelligence documents came to light during a separate case involving German steakhouse heiress Christina Block. Hamburg prosecutors accused Block of organising the kidnapping of her two youngest children in 2023 due to a custody dispute. Investigators allege Hanning was involved in an earlier attempted kidnapping, which he denies. Police reportedly found an electronic storage device containing sensitive information, including recent BND documents.

This is not the first time the BND has faced such controversy. In 2023, a high-ranking German intelligence officer was charged with treason for allegedly passing state secrets to Russia. Prosecutors claimed Carsten L shared intelligence about the war in Ukraine and the Wagner mercenary group and received about €400,000. His trial is ongoing.
paragraphs_zh: 据德国联邦检察官办公室称，曾于1998年至2005年领导德国联邦情报局（BND）的奥古斯特·汉宁因涉嫌间谍、叛国以及为外国势力获取机密信息而被捕。离开BND后，汉宁一直担任私人顾问。检察官称，他利用机密情报为一家外国情报机构撰写分析报告，并与另一家外国间谍机构保持联系。调查人员未透露涉及哪些外国势力。
警方还逮捕了前BND雇员曼弗雷德·D，他被指控以金钱为交换向汉宁传递了约2000份机密文件。曼弗雷德·D曾担任汉宁的办公室主任，并一直在BND工作到今年。他面临协助和教唆未遂叛国以及叛国间谍活动的指控。当地媒体报道称，汉宁在明斯特附近的诺德瓦尔德家中被捕，而曼弗雷德·D在巴伐利亚被捕。汉宁将于周三出庭，曼弗雷德·D将于周二出庭。
检察官表示，曼弗雷德·D在2012年至2026年间还担任过汉宁继任者的幕僚长，他利用职务之便获取高度机密信息，然后传递给汉宁以换取报酬。他们指出，多年来曼弗雷德·D向汉宁提供了约2000份文件，其中许多包含仅供BND内部使用的机密信息。有一次，汉宁涉嫌利用机密情报为一家外国情报机构的官员撰写分析报告，但尚不清楚这些材料是否到达了预定接收者手中。

汉宁还被指控与另一家外国情报机构的代表保持密切联系，多年来向对方传递政治信息，部分信息基于曼弗雷德·D提供的材料。当地媒体称，汉宁涉嫌持有情报文件一事是在另一起涉及德国牛排餐厅女继承人克里斯蒂娜·布洛克的案件中被发现的。汉堡检察官指控布洛克因监护权纠纷于2023年策划绑架她两个最小的孩子。调查人员称汉宁参与了更早的一次绑架未遂事件，但他本人否认。据报道，警方发现了一个电子存储设备，内含敏感信息，包括近期的BND文件。
这并非BND首次面临此类争议。2023年，一名德国高级情报官员因涉嫌向俄罗斯传递国家机密而被控叛国。检察官称卡斯滕·L分享了有关乌克兰战争和瓦格纳雇佣军集团的情报，并收受了约40万欧元。他的审判正在进行中。

title_original: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
summary_original: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.
body_original:
Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
By
Olivia Ireland
Published
6 hours ago
Former German spy chief August Hanning has been arrested on suspicion of espionage, treason and obtaining classified information for a foreign power, the German Federal Prosecutor's Office says.
Hanning headed the Federal Intelligence Service (BND) from 1998 to 2005 and has since been working as a private consultant.
Prosecutors allege that he used classified intelligence to "draft an analysis" for one foreign intelligence service and maintained contact with another foreign spying service. Investigators have not disclosed which foreign powers were involved.
Police also arrested former BND employee Manfred D, accusing him of passing Hanning about 2,000 classified documents for money.
Manfred D, who was Hanning's bureau chief and remained in the BND until this year, is charged with aiding and abetting attempted treason and treasonous espionage.
Local media reported Hanning was arrested at his home in Nordwalde near Münster while Manfred D was arrested in Bavaria. Hanning is due in court on Wednesday and Manfred D will appear on Tuesday.
Prosecutors say Manfred D, who also served as the chief of staff for Hanning's successors between 2012 and 2026, used his role to gain access to highly confidential information which he then passed on to Hanning "in exchange for remuneration".
"The current findings suggest that, over the years, Manfred D provided Hanning with approximately 2,000 documents, many of which contained classified information to be used exclusively by the Federal Intelligence Service for internal purposes," the statement says.
"On one occasion, Hanning used classified intelligence ... to draft an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service," prosecutors said, noting it was not clear if "the material reached the intended recipient".
Hanning is also accused of being "in close contact with a representative of another foreign intelligence service, to whom he passed on political information, partially based on material provided by Manfred D, for several years".
Local media say Hanning's alleged possession of intelligence documents came to light during a separate case relating to German steakhouse heiress Christina Block.
Hamburg public prosecutor's office accused Block of orchestrating the kidnapping of her two youngest children in 2023 due to a custody dispute. Investigators allege Hanning was involved in an earlier attempted kidnapping of the children, which he denies.
State criminal police officers reportedly discovered an electronic data storage device containing sensitive information including recent BND documents.
It is not the first time the BND has faced similar controversy. A high-ranking German intelligence officer was
charged with treason in 2023
for allegedly passing state secrets to Russia.
Prosecutors alleged Carsten L shared intelligence about the war in Ukraine and the Wagner mercenary group and received roughly €400,000 ($450,000; £340,000). His trial is ongoing.
